name: vLLM issue #56770: compressed-tensors MXFP4 W4A16 is misclassified as W4A4 and dispatched to a W4A4 kernel on SM100+
notes: AIME-24/25, GSM8K, MATH-500 comparison of BF16 vs MXFP4 W4A16 on the W4A4 kernel vs MarlinMxfp4Kernel. The quality gap on the W4A4 dispatch (avg 70.58%) vs Marlin (78.16%) vs BF16 (82.36%) is the silent-corruption evidence. Fix proposed separately as vLLM PR #56803.
